newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady on Monday as dealers in several locations across the United States noted better demand for nearby millfeed.
"There seems like there is good demand for nearby trucks for millfeeds," a Kansas dealer said. "I think business is starting to get a little bit better."
In Texas, nearby supplies remained tight partly due to reduced flour mill runtimes, a Texas dealer said.
"This is the tightest market I have seen," he said.
North Texas spot prices were traded at $80 a ton, he said.
Another dealer said that feed business was also better in Oklahoma and Missouri. But he noted on the whole, the market was quiet on Monday, waiting for direction.
